title: Folsom Site
summary: The Folsom Site in Wild Horse Arroyo, New Mexico, is a bison kill site found by cowboy George McJunkin after a 1908 flood. Excavators from the Denver Museum in 1926 found a spearpoint between two rib bones of a bison, in a deposit about 10,000 years old, pushing back the known human presence in North America by 6,000 years. It is on the National Register of Historic Places.

uncertainty.note: New Mexico Magazine: bones roughly 10,000 years old; NPS National Register: period of significance 7000-8999 BC.
